chunks: And whatever is in it from al-Husayn ibn Salim, I have narrated it from my father—may Allah be pleased with him—from Sa'd ibn 'Abd Allah, from Muhammad ibn al-Husayn ibn Abi al-Khattab, from 'Abd Allah ibn Jabalah, from Abu 'Abd Allah al-Khurasani, from al-Husayn ibn Salim.

key_terms.أَبِي: my father; the author’s immediate transmitter in this sanad/isnad
key_terms.الْحُسَيْنِ بْنِ سَالِمٍ: al-Husayn ibn Salim; the narrator to whom this transmission chain leads
key_terms.الْخُرَاسَانِيِّ: al-Khurasani; a nisbah identifying the narrator by regional attribution
key_terms.رَوَيْتُهُ: I narrated it; a transmission formula indicating direct reporting through a chain

ai.seo_question: What is the transmission chain to al-Husayn ibn Salim in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih?
ai.summary: This passage clarifies the sanad/isnad through which the author transmits reports from al-Husayn ibn Salim in Man La Yahduruhu al-Faqih. Its significance is bibliographical and hadith-critical, since it documents the chain of transmission rather than presenting a substantive matn.
